## Prerequisites

- Python 3.11+ with the virtual environment activated
- LM Studio running locally
- Telegram bot `.env` configured as in the existing project

```powershell
# From repo root
.venv\Scripts\Activate.ps1
```

---

## Key Files for This Feature

| File | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `src/storage/models.py` | Split-scope settings models, preset models, history policy model |
| `src/storage/session_store.py` | Session metadata and per-session history persistence |
| `src/bot/handlers/menu.py` | Top-level regenerate, removed inference section, expanded settings/preset menu flows |
| `src/bot/handlers/messages.py` | Chat inference backed by session history files |
| `src/bot/handlers/chats.py` | Session switch/delete cleanup behavior |
| `src/lms/sdk.py` | Session history selection and expanded generation config mapping |
| `src/lms/cli.py` | Model runtime settings application during load |
| `tests/unit/test_session_store.py` | Storage split and history cleanup tests |
| `tests/unit/test_menu.py` | Menu reshape and settings flow tests |
| `tests/integration/test_handlers.py` | End-to-end handler behavior for commands, sessions, and auto-delete |

## Manual Smoke Test Checklist

1. Open `/menu` and verify there is no Inference section.
2. Verify `Regenerate` is visible at the top level.
3. Open Settings and verify separate paths for model settings, session settings, and preset browsing.
4. Apply a model preset and verify only model-scoped values change.
5. Apply a session preset and verify only session-scoped values change.
6. View current settings and verify both scopes are summarized clearly.
7. Create two chat sessions, send different messages in each, switch sessions, and verify the next response uses the correct session context.
8. Delete a session and verify its history file is removed from disk.
9. Trigger command/menu result messages and verify they disappear after 5 seconds.
10. Send normal chat prompts and verify assistant replies remain visible.
